sections.heading: What is trending: “lives-sur-meuse”
paragraphs: “lives-sur-meuse” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for BE (snapshot taken 2026-08-13T12:00:09+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 500 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from L'Avenir, Le Soir, Sudinfo. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “Poursuivis par la police, Claude et sa sœur Émilia se sont noyés dans la Meuse à Lives : « Mon papa m’a appelé 30 minutes avant le drame, disant qu’il était tombé dans un traquenard »” — Sudinfo
“Deux personnes poursuivies par la police meurent noyées dans leur voiture” — Le Soir
“Deux morts après une course-poursuite à Namur : dans sa fuite, le conducteur a percuté une personne, indique le parquet de Namur” — L'Avenir

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Thu, 13 Aug 2026 03:50:00 -0700. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-08-13T12:00:09+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-08-13T12:00:35+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.
